DLC2313:4:t_017:5.en:
$$カヲル$$
「It isn't easy to simply empty your mind...」

DLC2313:4:t_017:6.en:
$$カヲル$$
「That's why they thought of a way to make it happen, even by force.」

DLC2313:4:t_017:8.en:
$$カヲル$$
「They understand what really matters. I'm sure they learned through failure and regret, over and over... dozens, hundreds of times.」

DLC2313:4:t_017:9.en:
$$カヲル$$
「I suppose an adult is someone who grows through those experiences.」

DLC2313:4:t_017:10.en:
$$カヲル$$
「The pilots of that mechanical angel are still climbing those steps, too.」

DLC2313:4:t_017:11.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Do you think... I can do it, too...?」

DLC2313:4:t_017:12.en:
$$カヲル$$
「You can. That's why I'm here.」

DLC2313:4:t_018:1.en:
$$カヲル$$
「That's it, $$シンジ$$. Let's move forward slowly.」

DLC2313:4:t_018:3.en:
???
「Those burdened with sin are not permitted to do so.」

DLC2313:4:t_019:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Do not bark, winged dog. I have no business with you today.」

DLC2313:4:t_019:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The power to change the world... You seek to use it to atone for your sins...」

DLC2313:4:t_020:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Out of my way, wingless one. The one I have business with is...」

DLC2313:4:t_023:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Every last one of you insists on interfering with me.」

DLC2313:4:t_023:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You dare treat me as a child, when I have lived for an eternity?」

DLC2313:4:t_023:3.en:
$$赤木$$
「I'll say it as many times as it takes! You're a selfish brat who can't control his own feelings!」

DLC2313:4:t_023:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Someone who tries to destroy the world over love and hate is no different from a kid throwing a tantrum!」

DLC2313:4:t_023:5.en:
$$赤木$$
「I don't know how things work where you come from, but in our world, someone who lets his emotions run wild and makes everyone else suffer is called a brat!」

DLC2313:4:t_023:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「It doesn't matter how long you've lived! You're a brat, $$ミカゲ$$!!」

DLC2313:4:t_023:7.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「...I came to invite that boy, but I've changed my mind.」

DLC2313:4:t_024:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You'll regret this, wingless ones. You have offended me.」

DLC2313:4:t_024:2.en:
$$アスカ$$
「I've heard enough of your selfish crap!」

DLC2313:4:t_025:0.en:
$$マリ$$
「If you think everything will go your way, you've got another thing coming.」

DLC2313:4:t_025:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Let's go, $$シンジ$$! Don't let a bastard like that keep lording it over you!」

DLC2313:4:t_025:4.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Remember, $$シンジ$$. Remember how it felt when you took that step a moment ago.」

DLC2313:4:t_025:6.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Slowly is fine. Just move one foot forward.」

DLC2313:4:t_025:7.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I wonder how heavy that one step must be for him...」

DLC2313:4:t_025:9.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$カイエン$$, $$ゼシカ$$! Switch with us!」

DLC2313:4:t_026:2.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「During Operation Yashima, you gave us courage, $$シンジ$$!」

DLC2313:4:t_026:3.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Don't forget how you felt back then!」

DLC2313:4:t_026:5.en:
$$アスカ$$
「You brat! For you, that was only a few months ago, and you can't remember it?!」

DLC2313:4:t_027:1.en:
$$赤木$$
「You did it, $$シンジ$$. You moved your feet.」

DLC2313:4:t_027:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step... Here we go!」

DLC2313:4:t_028:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ミカゲ$$! We... will never give up!!」

DLC2313:4:t_028:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Tch...! Any more of this, and I'll awaken something troublesome!」

DLC2313:4:t_029:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Running away the moment things don't go your way... You're a brat through and through.」

DLC2313:4:t_029:1.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Then let's clean up the toys he left behind.」

DLC2313:4:t_029:2.en:
$$隼人$$
「Heh... Cleaning up after kids is an adult's job.」

DLC2313:4:t_029:8.en:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ミコノ$$, $$ユノハ$$! Let's go, too!」

DLC2313:4:t_029:10.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Let's go, everyone! We can't let $$ミカゲ$$ or $$サイデリアル$$ do whatever they want with this world!!」

DLC2313:4:t_030:1.en:
$$渓$$
「That little force isn't enough to stop us now.」

DLC2313:4:t_030:3.en:
$$赤木$$
「Yeah. We've put in some work, and I'm hungry.」

DLC2313:4:t_030:4.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Are we done with the special training?」

review.context: Kaworu helps Shinji take a step; Mikage appears to tempt him with atonement. The adults reject Mikage's selfishness, the youths rally and Mikage flees.
decisions: Mikage's winged-dog insult addresses Amata; his wingless insult addresses Akagi and the humans.
The mechanical angel refers to Aquarion, not an Evangelion Angel or a Herald.
Shinji's I... and But... remain deliberately interrupted or trailing speech, preserving the matching rows.
